raw.unit: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section (see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C)).

context_quotes: see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C)
alternative_quotes: Court orders or decrees: (a) Name change orders; or (b) Divorce decrees;
Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or
unit_attributes.choice_quote: submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section
unit_attributes.choice_text: submission of one or more of: court orders or decrees (name change orders or divorce decrees); certificates of naturalization; marriage certificates; documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or documentation of customary usage
unit_attributes.action_quote: be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section
unit_attributes.action: document material discrepancies by submitting acceptable documentation
unit_attributes.object_quote: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity
unit_attributes.object: material discrepancies between application name and evidence of citizenship/nationality or identity
unit_attributes.summary: Material discrepancies between the application name and evidence of citizenship/nationality or identity must be documented by submitting one or more listed documents.
